title: The Geometry Game
description: This is based on constructions you might do in geometry. It has an infinitely large workspace and can handle large numbers of points. CIRCLE TOOL: Click on one point to set the center, then another to set the radius. LINE TOOL: Connect two points with a line. REMOVE CIRCLES: Remove all circles attached to one point. REMOVE POINT: Delete a point and all its attached circles and lines. CREATE POINT: Creates a point wherever you click. WASD to move, and have fun!

title: Casino
description: A half-finished casino game with fully functional blackjack and loans. You can change your bet amount, and change what kind of loans you get — though they do not have good interest rates. Blackjack is missing a few features such as splitting, but other than that it works wonderfully. There are also random encounters which can give you special rewards.

title: Connect Four
description: The classic Connect Four experience, except there is no win detection. I will add this soon, because I should know how to do that.

title: Wireframe 3D Rendering
description: Another attempt to render 3D objects. Any object that is behind you still gets rendered because of how negative values are handled. This is probably better than my Python versions, but it still is not good.
